desc:
👋 Welcome to Climb Keyboard Squishy Dumpling Tower!
🔥 MEGA UPDATE: 10 TOWERS! 🔥

Climb to the top on clicky keyboard keys... if the Dumplings let you. Every floor has its own jelly Dumpling hunting you. One bite and YOU'RE the filling!

🌍 NEW WORLDS: Jelly, Pop-It, Piano, Frost, Cloud Heaven, Lava, Jungle, Galaxy and the Dumpling King Castle! Earn Wins to open each gate.
🎹 Squish jelly, pop bubbles, play piano keys, slide on ice, bounce on clouds, dodge lava, float in low gravity!
🥟 New Dumplings: Chef, Angel, Devil, Lava, Brain, Holo... and the GIANT King!
🏆 20+ obbies with prizes, some behind puzzle doors.
🕳️ Secret tunnels and hidden rooms inside the tower.
👥 Invite friends = free Wins!

🎁 Join the group for a free BAT! https://www.roblox.com/communities/1031938595

Tags: Squishy Dumpling, Scary, Jumpscare, Survival, Tower, Climb, Keyboard, Obby
